'''FC Zimbru-2 Chișinău''' is a [[Moldova]]n [[association football|football]] team, which acts as the [[reserve team|reserve side]] of [[FC Zimbru Chișinău|Zimbru Chișinău]]. They play in [[Moldovan Liga 1|Liga 1]], the second tier of Moldovan football."}}
